title: Gamma expands ChatGPT slide context #gamma #chatgptapps #aipresentations
description:
Gamma expanded its ChatGPT integration with presentation creation that uses ChatGPT memory and chat history as built-in context. The result is a faster way to generate slides without repeatedly re-explaining the same project, topic, or workflow.

The update matters because it turns AI presentations into a context-aware workflow instead of a one-off prompt. By pulling prior conversations into slide creation, Gamma reduces setup friction and makes outputs more relevant for ongoing work.

For designers, teams, and knowledge workers, this points to a broader shift in AI apps: tools inside ChatGPT are becoming more personalized, connected, and useful for real production tasks rather than simple text generation.
